Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Studium Porter can now deliver up to five prepared prizes for one verified winner in a single incoming trade. Bundled dashboard claims and delivery updates are atomic and occur only after definitive game completion. Completed bundles emit one Progress notification for the existing Discord delivery channel, and Porter sends the editable first-name post-trade thank-you. Voluntary winner items and gil remain permitted gifts.
